title: Quadratic bit as a sum over unordered pairs
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The complete quadratic bit of $x$ equals the sum of $x_i x_j$ over all unordered pairs of distinct coordinates $\{i,j\}$.
